summary: Tested P1/P2 follow-ups on local OpenNext worker http://127.0.0.1:8787. Security/content-safety and curated-heading regressions passed via pytest + route validation. Product compare limit now uses global toast (no alert) and compare/RFQ flow works. Analytics transport verification is partially blocked by aborted /api/track requests during rapid route-change checks.

integration_issues.issue: During rapid products→home route-change checks, /api/track requests were observed as net::ERR_ABORTED and page_view payload capture was empty; exact runtime assertion of one settled page_view and stale-fallback drop could not be fully confirmed from browser traces.

action_items: Investigate /api/track net::ERR_ABORTED under rapid navigation; ensure analytics transport is resilient and observable in route-transition scenarios.
Re-run browser-level analytics gate and confirm exactly one settled page_view and no stale fallback page_view after route change.
Keep current P1/P2 content-safety and heading behavior unchanged (all regression checks passed).
critical_code_review_comments: No MOCKED APIs were used; all tests hit local worker endpoints and real app routes.
validateTrustedHtml rejects script/iframe/event-handler/javascript/data:text/html payloads; safeJsonLd escapes script-breaking characters and returns null for invalid JSON.
Curated heading map behavior is correct for required routes; uncurated routes preserve source semantic H1.
analytics.ts contains stale-fallback guard (drop page_view when pathname changes) and credentials: omit, but runtime transport still shows aborted /api/track in rapid transitions.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (core UI/content/compare checks passed; analytics transport runtime check partially blocked)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not retest selectors repeatedly: compare-limit toast and heading checks are stable. Focus next on analytics runtime observability: reproduce products→home rapid transition while capturing /api/track payloads to confirm one settled page_view and stale fallback drop without net::ERR_ABORTED noise.
rca of the issue: RCA (current evidence): transport-level cancellations during fast transitions are still present for /api/track (net::ERR_ABORTED). This prevents clean browser-trace confirmation of page_view payload sequencing, even though source-level stale-fallback guard exists in analytics.ts. Repro: route to /products, trigger rapid navigation to home via logo, observe aborted /api/track request(s).
